description: Figure 8 illustrates the relationship between sample size and the number of shared Top-6 routed experts, averaged across model layers, in two independent samples of a task. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Size” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 32, with tick labels at intervals of 4, and units are not specified. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Top-6 Routed Experts Averaged by Model Layers” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at intervals of 1, and units are not specified. There are two lines displayed: a blue dashed line and an orange solid line. The blue dashed line begins at approximately 0.4 shared experts at a sample size of 0, increases to approximately 5.6 shared experts at a sample size of 32, and exhibits a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations. The orange solid line begins at approximately 0.6 shared experts at a sample size of 0, increases to approximately 5.8 shared experts at a sample size of 32, and also exhibits a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations.
